current_difficulty_reason: Knowing that a weighted projective plane smooths to the plane does not extend the needed divisor class or guarantee a smooth member of its linear system on the partial smoothing. The authors control extension obstructions, compute the class/Picard and intersection scaling, and prove global generation and cohomology constancy for the relevant divisorial sheaves. Those new deformation and section-lifting results construct the smooth limit and its low-degree pencil before the standard gonality comparison, beyond merely applying the known Manetti surface classification.
